_meta.notes: Comprehensive index of all thematic clusters (Level 4) and sub-clusters (Level 5) for Papua New Guinea.

910.name: Earliest Human Settlement
910.description: Among the earliest human settlements outside Africa; Sahul migration route.

sub_clusters.name: Arrival via Sahul
sub_clusters.description: Maritime crossing from Southeast Asia; Huon Peninsula axe-flaking sites.

sub_clusters.name: Highlands Settlement
sub_clusters.description: Nombe and Kosipe cave sites; adaptation to highland environments.

910.name: Kuk Early Agriculture
910.description: Independent invention of agriculture at Kuk Swamp; one of world's earliest farming sites.

sub_clusters.name: Kuk Swamp Agricultural Phases
sub_clusters.description: Taro and yam cultivation; drainage ditches; UNESCO World Heritage site.

sub_clusters.name: Banana Domestication
sub_clusters.description: New Guinea as centre of origin for cultivated bananas.

920.name: Lapita Expansion through PNG
920.description: Austronesian Lapita peoples settle coastal PNG; interaction with Papuan populations.

sub_clusters.name: Lapita Coastal Settlements
sub_clusters.description: Pottery sites on Bismarck Archipelago and north coast; trade networks.

sub_clusters.name: Austronesian-Papuan Interaction
sub_clusters.description: Language exchange, intermarriage, blended cultural traditions.

920.name: Pre-Contact Highlands and Lowlands
920.description: 800+ language groups; big-man politics; elaborate exchange systems.

sub_clusters.name: Big-Man Political Systems
sub_clusters.description: Achievement-based leadership; moka exchange; competitive feasting.

sub_clusters.name: Kula Ring Trade Network
sub_clusters.description: Inter-island ceremonial exchange of armshells and necklaces in Milne Bay.

sub_clusters.name: Sepik River Art Traditions
sub_clusters.description: Elaborate spirit houses (haus tambaran), masks, sculptures; ritual artistry.

930.name: European Contact Period
930.description: Portuguese, Spanish, Dutch, and British explorers encounter New Guinea.

sub_clusters.name: Portuguese Sighting
sub_clusters.description: Jorge de Meneses names the island 'Ilhas dos Papuas'.

sub_clusters.name: Dampier and Bougainville Explorations
sub_clusters.description: William Dampier names New Britain; Bougainville charts Solomons and Bougainville.

940.name: Colonial Partition
940.description: Germany takes north (German New Guinea), Britain takes south (British New Guinea/Papua).

sub_clusters.name: German New Guinea
sub_clusters.description: New Guinea Company; plantation economy; Madang, Rabaul.

sub_clusters.name: British New Guinea / Territory of Papua
sub_clusters.description: British protectorate transferred to Australia 1906; Murray administration.

940.name: Australian Mandate Period
940.description: Australia seizes German territory in WWI; League of Nations mandate.

sub_clusters.name: Australian Capture of German New Guinea
sub_clusters.description: Australian Naval and Military Expeditionary Force seizes Rabaul.

sub_clusters.name: Gold Rushes and Highland Contact
sub_clusters.description: Edie Creek, Wau, Bulolo gold; first highland patrols; 'first contact'.

950.name: World War II in Papua New Guinea
950.description: Major Pacific theatre; Kokoda, Milne Bay, Rabaul, Bougainville.

sub_clusters.name: Fall of Rabaul
sub_clusters.description: Japanese capture major base; Lark Force destroyed; tunnel networks.

sub_clusters.name: Kokoda Track Campaign
sub_clusters.description: Australian defence of Port Moresby; jungle warfare; fuzzy wuzzy angels.

sub_clusters.name: Battle of Milne Bay
sub_clusters.description: First decisive land defeat of Japanese forces; Allied turning point.

sub_clusters.name: Bougainville Campaign
sub_clusters.description: US and Australian operations; Japanese garrison bypassed.

sub_clusters.name: House of Assembly
sub_clusters.description: First national parliament; increasing self-governance.

sub_clusters.name: Papua New Guinea Independence
sub_clusters.description: Independence 16 September 1975; Michael Somare first PM.

960.name: Bougainville Crisis
960.description: Secessionist conflict over Panguna mine; civil war; peace process.

sub_clusters.name: Panguna Mine and Conflict
sub_clusters.description: Environmental damage, landowner grievances, BRA insurgency, PNG military blockade.

sub_clusters.name: Bougainville Peace Process
sub_clusters.description: Burnham Truce, peace monitoring, autonomy agreement.

sub_clusters.name: Bougainville Independence Referendum
sub_clusters.description: 98% vote for independence; ratification pending.

960.name: Contemporary Papua New Guinea
960.description: LNG boom, governance challenges, climate vulnerability, cultural preservation.

sub_clusters.name: LNG and Resource Boom
sub_clusters.description: PNG LNG project; ExxonMobil; resource curse debates; landowner issues.

sub_clusters.name: Tribal Conflict in Modern PNG
sub_clusters.description: Highlands violence, election-related unrest, law and order challenges.

sub_clusters.name: Climate Vulnerability
sub_clusters.description: Carteret Islands relocation; sea level rise; extreme weather events.
